claim_scope: This audit measures unigram fit on ordered SAFE training blocks. It does not train a denoiser, generate or score molecules, rank generators, or establish that UDLM beats GenMol.

definitions.block_nll: negative mean log pi_j(w) over content tokens in the stated ordered training block
definitions.continuous_optimum: the unique interior root of the held-out log-likelihood derivative, found by 128 deterministic bisection iterations
definitions.stationary_prior: pi_j(w)=(1-w)c_j/sum_k(c_k)+w/V over all V=1880 token IDs

recommendation.qualification: The rule was formalized after exploratory inspection of these training blocks. It is suitable only as disclosed pilot hyperparameter engineering and is not confirmatory molecular-generation evidence.
recommendation.selection_rule: recommend 0.0002 only when both ordered-block continuous optima lie in [0.0001, 0.0003], both blocks contain tokens absent from the first-10000 prefix, and 0.0002 has lower unigram NLL than 0.01 on both; otherwise retain 0.01
